newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North says lifts Lake Cowal resource.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North says lifts Lake Cowal resource.

text.p: North Ltd said on Thursday it anticipated winning approval for the Lake Cowal gold mine, and has increased its resource base through continuing exploration.
North managing director Campbell Anderson told reporters after the annual general meeting that North could "clearly demonstrate there is no significant or lasting environmental impact" from the mine.
"We would anticipate getting the approval," he said.
Anderson also said continuing exploration in the area had increased the resource base beyond the initial application which had been based on producing two million ounces of reserves.
"We have been intersecting increased mineralisation," he said. "Resources are higher than that two million ounces already."
Asked to quantify the increase, Anderson said it was a significant gold area.
"We would have objectives of substantially increasing that resource, that's all I can say at this point."
The New South Wales state government in April refused a development application for the proposed A$180 million project on environmental grounds.
North has spent A$24 million during the past five years on developing and building the Lake Cowal project.
Anderson said North recognised that there was a belief that more should done environmentally, and this was being discussed with the New South Wales Department of Urban Affairs and Planning.
